method: Independent observation of the original PNG once, before drafting any geometry; no prior modern figure or spec consulted. Pixel positions below are approximate stroke locations, not calibrated data.

sourceFacts.fact: One graph, no subfigures, table, grid or ruled lattice. Two intersecting axes share the zero origin.
sourceFacts.pixels: Origin about (64,289); scan skew and stroke thickness are not mathematical slope data.

sourceFacts.fact: Horizontal temperature axis extends a short distance left of zero and much farther right. Its right end has an arrowhead. The label is italic t near the right end. No numerical temperature ticks or units are printed.
sourceFacts.pixels: Left axis end about (28,289), right arrow tip about (535,284); t near (503,313).

sourceFacts.fact: Vertical resistivity axis extends below the zero baseline and upward, with an upward arrowhead. It is labelled Greek rho near the top, not R. The only baseline value is the digit 0.
sourceFacts.pixels: Lower end about (65,331), upward tip about (61,13); rho near (33,43), 0 near (49,309).

sourceFacts.fact: The rising model meets the vertical axis above the origin. A short horizontal stroke extends left from this intercept. A vertical dimension arrow/interval marker at its left spans from the zero baseline to this intercept, with opposing end tips; rho subscript 0 is printed sideways beside it. This denotes the positive baseline resistivity, not a negative-temperature intercept.
sourceFacts.pixels: Intercept about (63,192); horizontal stroke runs about x29 to x64 at y192; interval marker at x37 between y194 and y286; rho0 beside its midpoint about (22,244).

sourceFacts.fact: Exactly one solid rising straight stroke starts at the positive rho0 intercept on the vertical axis and terminates at a finite upper-right endpoint. It has no curve arrowhead, endpoint dot, dashed continuation, second branch, turning point or queried numerical values. Its terminal temperature and resistivity, numerical slope and calibrated valid interval are not given.

modernAdditions: Clean orthogonal axes regularize scan skew, without changing the shared frame.
Semantic ink/accent/muted roles, uniform stroke widths and screen-readable Arial labels replace old printing.
The rho0 label is horizontal rather than sideways; its baseline-interval association is retained.
An inline maximum width of 640 and validation widths 640,342,331 are display metadata, not source data.
Hidden construction coordinates normalize the unscaled drawing. Numbers in geometry assertions are drawing-space coordinates, never claimed temperatures, resistivities, alpha values or fit limits.
notAdded: No numerical axis ticks, temperature endpoints, resistivity values, physical slope or range units.
No negative-temperature model branch, zero-resistivity intercept, extrapolation, curve arrowhead, caption rewrite or new formula.
No source endpoint dots or extra data points.
pointAndGridApplicability: The source has no discrete labelled point markers and no grid. Source features are axes, a finite segment and an interval marker, so native connects/displacement/pointOnLine assertions bind hidden construction endpoints to visible segments. No invisible point is falsely mapped as a visible source point, and objectCount is not used as a replacement for those relationships.
authoritativeInterpretation: The full SCI91-passed current lesson says rho=rho0(1+alpha t) is a finite-range approximation. The positive rising line is the depicted positive-coefficient case, not a claim for every material discussed in the lesson.
